name: New England
seasonNote: Open in Boston in late September to catch the Red Sox before the season ends, then ride the foliage north up the Maine coast and through the mountains as the leaves peak in early-to-mid October, working south through the Berkshires and Connecticut to close in Newport.
summary: The trip's opening act: colonial Boston, the Massachusetts coast and islands, the Maine coast and Acadia, the White Mountains and Green Mountains at peak foliage, the cultured Berkshires, and the Connecticut and Rhode Island shore.
